field_principles.action_impact_delta: Measures action-quality impact against the no-memory baseline.
field_principles.arms: Lists every memory-policy baseline compared on the same events.
field_principles.backward_retention_delta: Checks that prior families are retained within the regression bound.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_target: Bare boolean marking this as the required CSL slot.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each headline and gate field exists.
field_principles.forward_transfer_delta: Measures held-out transfer lift over the static causal policy.
field_principles.future_label_leakage_count: Guards against constructing memory from future exact labels.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal complete or blocked status for the conductor.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic exact-feedback memory policy search.
field_principles.memory_precision: Measures whether retrieved optimized memory actually supports exact success.
field_principles.n_events: Confirms the tournament reached the required 120-event horizon.
field_principles.optimized_vs_static_ci: Shows the held-out causal policy win excludes zero.
field_principles.poisoning_control: Shows poisoned memory is a positive control, not ignored.
field_principles.policy_ready: only a causal held-out policy win with bounded regression and successful rollback may persist.
field_principles.policy_search_space: Bounds self-optimization to memory operations only.
field_principles.prior_family_regression_max: Exposes the no-regression gate for prior families.
field_principles.promotion_thresholds: States the exact promotion gates for policy persistence.
field_principles.retrieval_cost: Accounts for memory reads so quality is not free context stuffing.
field_principles.rollback_success: Requires recovery to the last clean checkpoint after poison.
field_principles.seeds: Records the independent deterministic tournament seeds used for the CI.
field_principles.sessions: Shows the deterministic multi-session ASP/FSM stream, not a single short replay.
field_principles.weights_mutated: Confirms no model or verifier weights changed.
field_principles.write_amplification: Accounts for extra memory writes per event.
